name: AGENT_OUTCOME_SCORER_CONN_NO_SECRET_LQ917_20261108
comment: parsed PROJECT_ROOT/.env by hand for DB_PASSWORD and passed host='127.0.0.1', so the lane could not open a
session in a worktree (no .env), where the password is withheld (CANNOT_EMULATE needs_credential in the
2026-11-07 emulation), or over the peer socket. It now loads DB_* through env_bootstrap (name-bound), falls
back to the libpq PG* twin, defaults the host to /var/run/postgresql, and passes a password only when one is
configured. Pins: env-built session, peer-socket default with no password kwarg value, PGHOST honoured, DB_*
beats PG*, application_name = the lane id, no file named .env is opened, an unrelated switch in the env file
is not copied, and the hand-rolled parse / hardcoded TCP host are gone from the source. Stubbed connection;
no DB, no network, no credential.
